topic: Doflamingo capturing Law wasn't a defeat for Law's plan; it's the moment the plan actually starts working
title: Law Let Doflamingo Capture Him On Purpose
description: Doflamingo captures Law in the middle of Dressrosa, and most people read that as Law's plan falling apart. Here's why it's actually the moment the plan starts paying off. Does Law deserve more credit here than fans give him?
comment: Does Law's plan deserve more credit than the final punch Luffy throws, or does none of it matter without that punch? Pick one.

lines.text: Doflamingo captured Law. That's the exact moment Law's plan started working.

shot.fallback: pirate king carrying away a defeated captive

lines.text: Everyone treats this like Law's plan failing. I don't think it did.

shot.fallback: chained prisoner in a throne room

lines.text: Law's whole scheme was never really about saving Caesar Clown at all.

shot.fallback: mad scientist held captive by pirates

lines.text: It was about forcing Doflamingo to fight the World Government and Kaidou at the same time.

shot.fallback: king caught between two powerful forces

lines.text: Getting captured doesn't break that plan. It just means Doflamingo stops watching everything else.

shot.fallback: king distracted while guarding a prisoner

lines.text: While he's busy questioning Law, an army of tiny allies is sneaking toward a target named Sugar.
Knock her out, and every citizen Doflamingo ever turned into a toy remembers the truth at once.

shot.fallback: toys transforming back into people suddenly

lines.text: That's the real bomb Law's distraction bought time for, and Doflamingo never saw it coming.

shot.fallback: tiny warriors preparing a final move

lines.text: Thirteen years of waiting taught Law exactly how patient a trap needs to be.
So no, Doflamingo didn't capture Law. Law let the rest of the trap finish itself.

shot.fallback: surgeon pirate watching a plan unfold

lines.text: Because Doflamingo capturing Law was never the moment the plan broke...

shot.fallback: pirate king carrying away a defeated captive

self_check.hook: line 1 states the contrarian claim (capture = plan working) in the first 2 seconds
self_check.loop: last line restates the setup and leads straight into line 1's payoff
